description: This Java class implements a provider for LoRaWAN devices via the Things Network API. It extracts device identifiers, payload data, and normalized data from incoming JSON messages.

classes.name: ThingsNetworkProvider
classes.description: A provider class implementing the LoraProvider interface for handling LoRaWAN messages from the Things Network.

methods.name: getProviderName
methods.description: Returns the name identifier for this provider, 'ttn'.

methods.name: pathPrefix
methods.description: Provides the URL path prefix associated with this provider, '/ttn'.

methods.name: extractDeviceId
methods.description: Extracts the device EUI from the incoming LoRa message JSON object.

methods.name: extractPayload
methods.description: Extracts the raw payload string from the incoming message.

methods.name: extractNormalizedData
methods.description: Creates a normalized data map from the LoRa message, including the function port if available.
